description: Create or revise the durable background work intent. Asynchronous: it queues or updates the work and returns immediately; it never waits for the work to run. Include task_id (from your task list) to revise existing work with the complete revised description; omit it to create new work.

work.description: Complete description of the work to perform. For a revision, restate the entire revised work, not just the change.

task_id.description: Existing task to revise. Only use a task_id supplied in your input; never invent one.
